headline: DeepSeek Packs More Model Into Less Cost
lede: DeepSeek’s V4.1 Flash snapshot routes a vast mixture-of-experts system through a compact active footprint. Image input, compressed KV caching, and long-context agent work arrive at a price aimed squarely at everyday coding and terminal use.

headline: Ultramarine Cuts Tokens Without Cutting Ambition
lede: Ultramarine 1 Flash promises business-ready documents, spreadsheets, and presentations with a smaller output budget. Its internal benchmark makes a careful case for near-frontier work at roughly thirteen cents per task, though the comparison invites scrutiny.

headline: Tesla’s Roadster Still Promises the Impossible
lede: Tesla’s second-generation Roadster pairs a claimed 1.9-second sprint with a 250-plus-mph top speed and 620-mile range. The specification sheet is spectacular; the production calendar remains the harder engineering problem.

headline: Preview Local LLM Speed Before Buying Hardware
lede: Llmspeed turns a hardware-shopping question into an interactive experiment. Choose a device and model, compare token rates and time to first token, then remember that estimates are only as faithful as the setups behind them.

headline: DeepSeek Ships a Smaller, Faster Open Model
lede: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 arrives under the MIT license with a million-token context window and tools for Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and local inference. The release targets reasoning, coding, vision, and agents—without requiring a cloud endpoint.

headline: Lingua Franca Makes Concurrent Time Explicit
lede: Lingua Franca treats timing, causality, and coordination as part of the program rather than incidental thread management. Its reactor model carries familiar C, C++, Python, TypeScript, and Rust components toward deterministic real-time systems.

headline: The .name Domain Exit Has Arrived
lede: Third-level .name domains are scheduled for permanent removal next year. Owners must move websites, mail, and dependent services before a registry decision becomes an identity and infrastructure outage.

headline: A Jailbroken PS5 Becomes a Local AI Box
lede: PS5LM gives a liberated console a second career as an offline language-model server. llama.cpp, GGUF models, and the machine’s shared memory turn living-room hardware into a surprisingly capable homebrew experiment.

headline: Transformers Remember More Than They Seem
lede: A clear tour of associative memory recasts linear layers, MLPs, and attention as different ways to store and retrieve key-value pairs. The analogy explains why attention can preserve far more temporary context than a simple learned lookup.
pullquote: Attention is a memory system that learned how to ignore the noise.

headline: Claude Traces the Origins of ECDSA Seeds
lede: A decades-old cryptographic mystery now points to timestamp-seeded lrand48 calls in the late 1990s. The reconstruction eases fears of hidden phrases or deliberate backdoors, while several remaining seeds and base points keep the archive partly open.
